Chhattisgarh Government Approves Startup Mission and Export Policy

The Chhattisgarh government has approved a Rs 500 crore "Chief Minister Startup Mission" aimed at creating new opportunities for the state's youth. The cabinet also sanctioned the "Export Promotion Policy 2026-30" to boost trade. These decisions were made during a cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister Vishnu Deo Sai. The startup mission is intended to foster entrepreneurship and provide a platform for new ventures. The export policy seeks to enhance the state's presence in international markets.
